responsibility: Provides the trait solver’s search-graph execution engine for evaluating goals with recursion and cycles, coordinating stack-based evaluation, cycle detection, provisional per-cycle state, fixpoint reruns, ambiguity and overflow handling, and interaction with cached results. Its core framework defines the solver-facing context and delegate traits and drives when goals may be reused or inserted, while the global_cache component supplies the persistent solved-goal cache, including depth- and nested-cycle-aware validation of cached entries, separation of overflow-safe versus overflow-tainted results, and storage of tracked dependencies needed for sound reuse.
